$comment: Machine-checked invariants. policy.ts validates structure; the enforcing check must exist and pass. Add no invariant without an enforcing check.

invariants.statement: No authored Python files, manifests, or invocations in maintained code and tooling
Every skill in .agents/skills has valid frontmatter, name matching directory, and referenced commands exist in package.json or the repo
Plugins declaring paid or computer capabilities cannot activate without an explicit recorded grant
Browser/computer harness code contains no stealth, anti-detection, or CAPTCHA-bypass patterns
No secrets (tokens, private keys) are committed
Offline eval datasets are non-empty and deterministic; a check may not pass with zero registered checks
Site-access default-deny list includes bot-prohibiting sites (linkedin.com)
